# Raul Valle - Official Website

> Personal academic and research website for Raul Valle (University of Florida Ph.D. student in Electrical and Computer Engineering), focused on signal processing, time-series machine learning, neuroengineering, and research software.

Use this file as the primary entry point for LLM-assisted browsing of this site. Prefer canonical URLs on `https://www.raulv.dev/` and rely on page-specific metadata and structured data in each page when available.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.raulv.dev/): Site overview and featured work.
- [About](https://www.raulv.dev/about.html): Background, research orientation, affiliations, writing, recognition, and selected visual work.
- [CV](https://www.raulv.dev/cv.html): Education, experience, skills, and credentials.
- [Research](https://www.raulv.dev/research.html): Main research themes, projects, publications, talks, and public proof.
- [Contact](https://www.raulv.dev/contact.html): Preferred ways to reach out.

## Research Detail Pages

- [Computational NeuroEngineering Lab](https://www.raulv.dev/research-cnel.html): Work related to neuroengineering and lab activity.
- [IEEE SPS at UF](https://www.raulv.dev/research-sps.html): Signal processing society and chapter-related technical work.

## Secondary Archives

- [Notes](https://www.raulv.dev/blog.html): Technical notes and essays; linked from About.
- [Photography](https://www.raulv.dev/photography.html): Photography portfolio and captions; linked from About.
- [Awards](https://www.raulv.dev/awards.html): Honors and distinctions; linked from About.

## Machine-Readable Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://www.raulv.dev/sitemap.xml): Complete list of indexable URLs.
- [Robots](https://www.raulv.dev/robots.txt): Crawl policy and sitemap declaration.
